digest.component_or_area: plan-review G7 criteria routing and rubric
propositions: G7 routing entry default_posture must change from 'advisory' to 'blocking' with block_threshold lowered from 0.95 to 0.85 to enable blocking on high-validity findings across 348 historical cases with zero clearly-incorrect findings at >= 0.85 priority

Plan-review blocking at 0.85 threshold admits both floor-grade kinds (contradicts_reality and omits_required_site with impact 1.0 floor) and incomplete_enumeration (impact 0.55, never blocks via divergence axis), with kind scoping driven by existing plan-v4 grading per ADR 0054

G7 rubric must add four rule patterns: abstain-with-coverage on unresolvable parent (FAIL-OPEN), closed-parent checked against final state with explicit sibling-handoff scope exclusion, one-finding-per-contradicted-parent-clause dedup-at-source (c97a T5c pattern), and floor-kind guidance to distinguish genuine contradictions from cosmetic mismatches

Pinned blocking-set assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, and test_plan_review_g7.py must be updated to reflect G7 at (0.85, 'blocking') via new G7_BLOCKING constant and posture pin update

New test_g7_blocking.py using real orchestrator.pass3_over_findings wrapper and impact_plan must validate contradicts_reality and omits_required_site block while incomplete_enumeration stays advisory, including boundary case at priority 0.85
Criteria guide must be regenerated via registry regenerate-criteria-guide command with no implementation changes to pass3_decide or threshold_for kernel functions
